sentences: rs4988235 is an intron variant in MCM6 (NM_002299.2(LCT):c.-13907C>T) with alleles G>A, G>C, and G>T [F2, F1].

The alternate A allele (G>A) is present on about 40% of alleles in gnomAD v4 genomes (60356/152102; af 0.396813) and its frequency varies by ancestry, being highest in European (non‑Finnish) at 64% (43184/67976) and lowest in East Asian at 0.21% (11/5186) [F4, F5].
ClinVar classifies this variant as associated with lactase persistence, though no assertion criteria are provided [F6].
